## Local Docker qualification, 2026-10-08
reference: Nextflow 26.04.6, Docker Engine 29.8.2, Linux amd64
source: copies of nf-core-text/pipelines at the revisions in nf-core-text/revisions.txt; no pipeline edits
commands: nice -n 19 nextflow run <copy> -profile test,docker --outdir out -c limits.config; nice -n 19 target/release/iunctus run <copy> -profile test --outdir out -executor local -max-pending 4 -no-cache
limits: reference executor.cpus=4, executor.memory='16 GB'; iunctus uses a fresh XDG_CACHE_HOME per pipeline
comparison: SHA-256 and file lists of published outputs; only pipeline_info/** is excluded; dated names become <time>. No scientific output, FastQC report, MultiQC data or plot is excluded.
evidence: locally excluded .claude/production-readiness-evidence/nfcore-20261008/ retains logs and complete output manifests; temporary source/run/work/cache folders are removed after recording.
